extracted.name: Shrimp Mozambique
extracted.description: Leave the shells on in this recipe for bold, savory-tasting shrimp Mozambique, a legendary Portuguese dish infused with white wine, beer, and sazón.
ingredient_lines: 3 (1.41 ounce) packages sazon seasoning with saffron (such as Goya® Azafran)
1 pound large shrimp, shells left on
3 cups cooked white rice, or to taste
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion and garlic; cook until tender but not brown, about 5 minutes. Stir in beer, sazón, white wine, hot sauce, and salt; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer for 15 minutes.
Add shrimp to the skillet; cook until pink, 3 to 4 minutes. Add rice; cook until heated through, about 5 minutes. Stir in parsley.
